identityHelp: People without a login are listed here. A student's login is the student record number. A staff login is E followed by the staff number, so it does not clash with a student number. The first password is that same login ID, and the account is marked for a password change.
accountCreated: Login {{username}} was created. The first password is that same ID.
name: Name
emptyPeople: Everyone in this list already has a login.
resetToIdDone: The password is the login ID again, and the account is marked for a password change. Older sessions were signed out.
yearLockedDone: The year is locked. Teachers cannot change marks.
yearArchivedDone: The year is in the archive.
yearRolled: The next Ethiopian year is open on semester 1 (Meskerem–Tir).
ecYearHint: Use the Ethiopian calendar year, four digits, for example 2018.
protocolHelp: Lock turns submitted marks into an approved record. Unlock returns them to draft and needs a written reason. An archived year cannot be reopened.
monitorHelp: Download a SQL file for this school only, or record that an external backup was checked. Outbound notices to the woreda or Ministry are logged here too.
schoolBackupHelp: Download a SQL backup of this school only (rows with your tenant id). Other schools are not included. The file contains password hashes — store it securely.
noRuns: No backup check has been recorded.
noNotices: No outbound notice has been recorded.
ticketHelp: Teachers and offices report account, network, computer, and mark problems here. The technician updates the status.
title: Title
auditHelp: Who changed accounts, the academic year, marks, duties, tickets, and backup checks.
emptyAudit: No activity has been recorded yet.
importTitle: Import logins from Excel or CSV
importHelp: In Excel, save the sheet as CSV. The first row may be kind,id. Each following row is student or staff, then the record number. Example: student,12
healthHelp: People active in the last 15 minutes, failed sign-ins in the last 24 hours, and the server process. On Windows the load numbers are often zero; memory is the useful server figure.
dutiesHelp: One homeroom teacher for each section. One department head for each subject department in the current Ethiopian year. These are duties, not new login roles.
